statement: FINRA15-02816 names Scout Trading LLC claimant and Wedbush Securities Inc respondent; claim filed on or aboutOctober22,2015. Pleaded claims are breach of contract, conversion and accounting concerning a Clearing Agreement; the award does not identify which cause of action supplied the damages theory.
The award orders Wedbush to pay Scout USD237594 compensatory damages and USD1250 reimbursement of the nonrefundable filing fee; the award establishes obligations, not actual payment or collection.

Award paragraph2 sets4.5%annual interest fromAugust19,2014 through and including the date of the award, and9%annual interest from the date of the award until paid in full. No interest total or assumed payment date is calculated.

Wedbush counterclaim is denied; other relief not specifically addressed, including attorneys fees, is denied. This does not reverse the separate regulatory settlement or establish exoneration of regulatory findings.

statement: The relief-requested section printsUSD237594 for requested clearing-agreement damages andUSD237549 for the alternative conversion/property request. The panel awardsUSD237594. Preserve the figures without declaring a typographical correction.

The panel assessesUSD9550 hearing-session fees to Wedbush payable to FINRA. Those fees are distinct from Scout reimbursement and regulatory fines; neither procedural fees nor the award are new regulatory penalties against Bleich.

Probable firm-identity inference: the award claimant is the Scout Trading LLC CRD151990 in the regulatory records, supported by exact firm name, same Wedbush relationship and matchingUSD675000 regulatory-settlement context. Award itself gives no Scout CRD and does not name Bleich; a name-collision possibility is not eliminated.
